text_en: And again I looked up and saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains of bronze.
text_cn: 我再举目观望，看，有四辆车由两山间出来；这两座山都是铜山。

text_en: The first chariot had red horses, the second chariot black horses,
text_cn: 第一辆车套着栗色的马，第二辆车套着黑色的马，

text_en: the third chariot white horses, and the fourth chariot dappled gray horses.
text_cn: 第三辆车套着白色的马，第四辆车套着杂色的马，都很雄壮。

text_en: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord? ”
text_cn: 我问那与我谈话的使者说：“我主，这是什么意思？”

text_en: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of heaven going out, after presenting themselves before the Lord of all the earth.
text_cn: 使者答应我说：“这些是侍立在全地的主宰之前，而今向天下四方出发的：

text_en: The chariot with the black horses goes toward the north country, the white ones go toward the west country, and the dappled ones go toward the south country. ”
text_cn: 那套着黑马的，向北方出发，白马则跟在后面出发，杂色的向南方出发。”

text_en: When the steeds came out, they were impatient to get off and patrol the earth. And he said, “Go, patrol the earth. ” So they patrolled the earth.
text_cn: 这些雄壮的马出来，切愿在地上往来巡逻。他于是说：“你们去，在地上巡逻吧！”它们就在地上巡逻。

text_en: Then he cried out to me, “Lo, those who go toward the north country have set my spirit at rest in the north country. ”
text_cn: 以后，他呼唤我，对我说：“你看，向北方出发的，已在北方平息了上主的怒气。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
Collect silver and gold from the exiles—from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah—who have arrived from Babylon; and go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
text_cn: “你该由归来的俘虏手中，即由赫耳待、托彼雅和耶达雅的手中取些礼物，就在今天，到从巴比伦回来的责法尼雅的儿子约史雅的家里去。

text_en: Take the silver and gold and make a crown, and set it on the head of the high priest Joshua son of Jehozadak;
text_cn: 你要拿银子和金子，做一顶冠冕，戴在大司祭约匝达克的儿子耶叔亚的头上，

text_en: say to him: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Here is a man whose name is Branch: for he shall branch out in his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord .
text_cn: 然后对他说：万军的上主这样说：看，有一个人名叫“苗芽”，他要自动萌芽，他要建筑上主的殿宇。

text_en: It is he that shall build the temple of the Lord ; he shall bear royal honor, and shall sit upon his throne and rule. There shall be a priest by his throne, with peaceful understanding between the two of them.
text_cn: 是他要建筑上主的殿，是他要承受尊荣，坐在宝座上执政；并且有一位司祭立在他右边，他们二人之间必和平相处。

text_en: And the crown shall be in the care of Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah son of Zephaniah, as a memorial in the temple of the Lord .
text_cn: 这顶冠冕要存在上主的殿内，作为赫耳待、托彼雅、耶达雅和责法尼雅的儿子约史雅的纪念。

text_en: Those who are far off shall come and help to build the temple of the Lord ; and you shall know that the Lord of hosts has sent me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God.
text_cn: 远方的人必来共同建筑上主的殿；如此，你们便知道：是万军的上主派遣了我到你们这里来。如果你们真听从上主你们天主的声音，这事必要实现。”
